## About Me

I am a software engineering student focused on building practical software systems, backend applications, and AI-powered products.

I enjoy turning ideas into working systems — from APIs and business applications to AI-assisted developer tools — while continuously learning, experimenting, and improving my engineering skills.

| **Software Engineering** | Building maintainable software systems, APIs, business logic, and applications. |

| **Applied AI** | Integrating modern AI models into practical applications, automation workflows, and developer tools. |
| **Product Building** | Turning ideas into functional products by combining engineering, architecture, and user-focused design. |
